messages.author: a440d9e84d6ded68
messages.subject: IRACE for SAT scenarios
parts:
Hello

I want to ask how can I use IRACE to tune the SPEAR and SAPS algorithm for SAT instances,
Do I need to write a special wrapper script? (I'm not familiar with this)

I look forward to your help, thank you

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: IRACE for SAT scenarios
parts:
Hi,

I attach two parameter files and a target-runner (special wrapper script) for Spear written in bash that will run on Linux.

I don't have one for SAPS but it should be similar. If you create one, would you mind sharing it?

You may find more examples in http://aclib.net/ (but those may be a bit outdated).

irace 3.2 can also use the GenericWrapper4AC designed for SMAC: see https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/irace/NEWS and look for --aclib in the documentation.

I hope the above helps.

Cheers,

Manuel

/home/ryou/spear-tune/target-runner 1 3 316580360 /home/ryou/spear-tune/SWV-scrambled-first302/dspam_dump_vc1091.cnf   --sp-var-dec-heur 7 --sp-learned-clause-sort-heur 9 --sp-orig-clause-sort-heur 6 --sp-res-order-heur 3 --sp-clause-del-heur 1 --sp-phase-dec-heur 5 --sp-resolution 2 --sp-variable-decay 1.4 --sp-clause-decay 1.1 --sp-restart-inc 1.7 --sp-learned-size-factor 1.6 --sp-learned-clauses-inc 1.5 --sp-clause-activity-inc 1.5 --sp-var-activity-inc 0.5 --sp-rand-phase-dec-freq 0.01 --sp-rand-var-dec-freq 0.01 --sp-rand-var-dec-scaling 0.9 --sp-rand-phase-scaling 0.9 --sp-max-res-lit-inc 1 --sp-first-restart 3200 --sp-res-cutoff-cls 16 --sp-res-cutoff-lits 1600 --sp-max-res-runs 1 --sp-update-dec-queue 0 --sp-use-pure-literal-rule 1

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: [irace-package] Re: IRACE for SAT scenarios
parts:
Hi Ryo,

I'm happy that it works but I'm not sure what you mean by Unix vs DOS format.
The file I attached is using Linux line-endings and I'm running it in Linux.
Perhaps Google Groups or your browser converted it to the wrong format.

Glad that you found the problem. If you have any suggestions about how to make
the target-runner more robust against such Windows vs Linux differences, I'll
be happy to know.

Also, please note that no source code is available for Spear and we do not know
what this executable is actually doing. We do NOT recommend running this
executable in your computer. Unless you absolutely must run Spear, we suggest
to use a different scenario for which source code is available.

Best,

Manuel.
